source: https://arammayhem.com/data/ plus Data Dragon 16.22.1 item map and purchase fields
rules: Do not apply the Ranked/Summoner's Rift map-11 validator or Ranked editorial taxonomy.
Final inventory choices must exist in the Mayhem item snapshot or have explicit Data Dragon map-12 availability and be purchasable.
Transformation targets may be shown as final inventory items only when their acquisition path is recorded; the consumed component is not a second inventory slot.
Unknown item metadata is treated as unknown, never as proof of incompatibility.
Arena-exclusive items are not included by using Mayhem map-12 eligibility; do not infer Arena eligibility from generic damage tags.
limitations: The reusable Mayhem item statistics snapshot is 26.21. 26.22 item availability changes are not enumerated in Riot's patch notes; where no 26.22 mode-specific source confirms availability, the UI must expose the snapshot patch and avoid claiming current-patch statistical support.
